filing_office: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation
filing_fee_notes: Standard filing is 100; expedited filing totals 150. Electronic payments incur the separately listed 4.5 convenience fee. The 300 annual-report fee may be waived for approved MarylandSaves participants.
registered_agent_rules: Designate a resident agent with a Maryland physical address, not a P.O. box. The agent must sign consent to serve.
standard_processing_time: Standard filing: 6-8 weeks, according to the May 2026 formation instructions.
expedite_options: Formation instructions list 150 total for 7-14-business-day expedited filing; same-day totals are 425 online or 525 for paper drop-box/in-person delivery.
annual_report_name: Form 1 Annual Report and Business Personal Property Return
annual_report_due: April 15 annually; SDAT offers a requested 60-day extension.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Maryland Department of Labor, Division of Unemployment Insurance
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and obtain the resident agent's consent. File the annual report and any required personal-property return.
common_mistake: Assuming the annual-report fee pays any personal-property tax owed.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Annual-report fee is separate from any property tax; the online filing asks questions to determine whether a property return is required. Some fee/form information was verified through official indexed documents where direct retrieval was blocked.
